short_symptom: Dual Venturi Gas Valve Stepper Error
plain_english_meaning: Gas mixer venturi stepper motor feedback position error.
diagnostic_and_fix_steps: Disconnect power from the Navien NCB-240 / NCB-110H; verify zero voltage at the incoming terminal block using your Bluetooth OBD2 Diagnostic Scanner.
Unscrew the primary compartment cover to expose the Dual Venturi Gas Valve Mixer Assembly; check wiring harness and harness clips for damage or corrosion.

Probe the test pins of the Dual Venturi Gas Valve Mixer Assembly using your Bluetooth OBD2 Diagnostic Scanner: expected normal reading is Coil Resistance: 500–1,500 Ω; verify operating voltage signal.
Disconnect electrical connectors, remove mounting hardware, and mount the certified replacement Dual Venturi Gas Valve Mixer Assembly (OEM #30011533A).
Power on the Navien Combi Boiler, perform the control reset sequence, and verify the display clears error E060 during active operation.

short_symptom: Cold Water Inlet Thermistor Open Circuit
plain_english_meaning: Inlet water thermistor reading infinite resistance.
diagnostic_and_fix_steps: Isolate electrical power and fuel/water supplies to the Noritz Tankless Water Heater before servicing; test incoming lines with your Digital Multimeter.
Remove the service access panel using hand tools to visually inspect the Inlet Temperature Thermistor Sensor (OEM #EK095) and wiring harness for burn marks or loose terminals.

Measure electrical resistance across Inlet Temperature Thermistor Sensor terminals using your Digital Multimeter; compare test values against factory specification (Normal Resistance: 10k–12k Ω at 25°C / 77°F (NTC curve)).
If test results show open circuit or resistance is out of spec, unbolt and install the replacement Inlet Temperature Thermistor Sensor (OEM #EK095).
Reassemble all access covers, restore power, clear diagnostic fault memory, and run a test cycle to confirm error Code 31 is resolved.
